summary: Deputies were sent to reports of 10 to 15 people fighting outside a Main Street location, including a call from a neighbor who saw the group. A firearm was mentioned during the reports.

area: 95th Street West at Rosamond Boulevard, Rosamond area
disposition: reinforcements requested: water tender and two additional wildland engines
summary: Crews took a grass and brush fire burning three to four acres with a moderate rate of spread and wind out of the west. Command requested a water tender and two additional wildland engines.
Engine and truck companies were sent to a fire on the East Terrace Way block with no further information available at dispatch.
Officers were sent to a Quincy Street apartment after a woman reported that her daughter's boyfriend was assaulting her.
Officers were sent to the Norris Road area after a report of a young person going door to door asking for help and then running east.
A semi pulling an aluminum trailer was reported unable to maintain its lane southbound on Interstate 5 just north of Highway 46, and an officer was sent to check on it.
Eastbound Highway 58 at Mohawk was placed under a full closure set to run until 5 a.m.
Two units were sent to a Terrace Way apartment complex after a caller reported that neighbors were in possession of their pet bearded dragon, which had been missing for several months.
Officers responded after a caller reported a brother-in-law at their front door.
A man in a black and pink top was reportedly seen with a crowbar trying to open a tan four-door sedan before leaving the area.
An ambulance crew was flagged down at an F Street address for a patient in an alley, and the call cleared shortly afterward.
Crews were sent to a San Marino Drive address for a person who had contact with a pesticide.
A caller reported a man who appeared to be under the influence inside a travel center store before walking out to a white sedan with a spare tire on the left side.
